_comment: Person records judged by hand from their publication titles: 1 where one
record holds several people's work, 0 where it is one person with range.
Ids belong to this corpus snapshot, so the set only measures anything on a
database that still contains them — scripts/measure_conflation.py says so
and skips the rest rather than pretending.
Written to settle whether a proposed change to the detector helps. Three
were tried against it and did not: requiring the two groups to cover a
share of the work, topic-graph distance between them, and whether their
active years overlap. The numbers are in rip/conflation.py.
